keystore: build/android/chromium-debug.keystore (in the Chromium tree; alias chromiumdebugkey)
note: The V2 signing certificate every APK from this repo must carry. Both the development and release chains sign with the Chromium tree's public test keystore, so the certificate is the same for every build. The delivery gate fails the hop if a build ever signs with a different key: a key change is a deliberate, user-visible migration (every installed user must uninstall and reinstall), never a silent accident. Update this fingerprint ONLY when the signing key is intentionally rotated, and say so in the commit message.
